answer: At the dawn of autonomous verification, we map computational lineage much like sequencing an entire atlas to pinpoint precise genomic insertion sites. Every agent transcript undergoes strict restriction digest parsing, flagging silent mutations or sequence anomalies akin to hunting stray sparrow guides bound to unintended loci. The attacker must pay an exponential compute penalty to synthesize millions of viable cryptographic guides that escape off-target cleavage, though homologous recombination can still bypass our filters.
